en.text: They took out the Pigeon Lady!
They took out the Chess Guy!
They took out the Test Pilot!
They took out the Rat King!
Can't forget to upgrade my powers.
I may have pushed too deep.
I'm lucky to get out alive.
I gotta get out of here…
I need all the help I can get.
I have to make this count…
I put an end to their little streak.
Be careful, they have the Rejuvenator.
Let's regroup and prepare a defense.
Come out and meet your fate…
They have to be around here somewhere.
They won't be bothering us for a while…
If only killing Hathorne was this easy…
No one is getting in my way.
You won't be stopping me, Sheriff.
The Detective is no threat to me.
I won't let you hook me.
It would have been safer for her in the library.
Not all stories have a happy ending.
I never cared much for fantasy stories.
She was rather chipper, now wasn't she?
Sometimes you have to be willing to go for soft targets.
You're not as clever as you think, Paradox.
I dealt with the Time Thief.
I won't let Paradox ruin my chance at revenge.
She won't bring me out of the sky…
You should have stayed at The Baroness.
You mind games end here, Doorman.
You'll pay for what you've done, Drifter.
The Professor won't be supporting his team for a while.
The Professor is no longer a threat.
Perhaps you're more suited for the classroom, Professor.
We won't need to worry about any more black holes for a bit.
The little night terror is dead.
Just because he's cute doesn't mean he's not dangerous.
You were outclassed from the beginning, Apollo.
A swordsman couldn't kill a sniper, I'm shocked.
I know well the danger a teenager can bring.
You picked the wrong side, Apollo.
Sorry Miss McGinnis, this isn't your day.
Her inventions are novel, but not enough.
She was a brilliant mind, but brilliance does precious little against a bullet.
The pain doesn't go away, Victor.
I wish you luck on finding answers another day, Victor.
Victor, this is not your day.
Your wealth does not impress, Lady Geist.
We all have sins we must answer for.
Oathkeeper will die with you, Geist.
That woman thought I'd be easy prey.
I couldn't have Seven running around.
That should buy us some breathing room.
I won't let the government take any more lives.
I won't be your victim, Haze.
I don't answer to the OSIC.
All the money in the world couldn't save them.
I know you wanted to help your friend, but I won't let you get in my way.
His travels have come to an end.
Only I have dominion of the sky.
I can't have you grabbing my friends, Krill.
You're not bad, Lash, but you're not me.
You didn't honestly think you could stop me, Lash?
I could feel his arrogance from here.
I have no time for your petty squabbles.
If they got their act together, they might actually be a threat.
The plight of the Djinn is none of my concern.
Hopefully your master will be forgiving, Mirage.
He was a man of conviction, but conviction only gets you so far.
You can't hide from me, Calico.
Some assassin she turned out to be…
Don't worry, I'll find Ava a home.
Ava will be well looked after.
That should knock her down a peg.
You shouldn't have tried to stop me, Graves.
Graves, I thought you were supposed to help the dead. Why are you fighting me?
Focus on your schooling, Graves, it's much safer.
Your mentor has led you astray, Graves.
I prayed it wouldn't come to this.
I never wanted to do this, Wesley.
He would do the same thing in my position.
Only one of us gets revenge today, Wesley.
He'll come back to kill me, and I'll be ready.
You came a long way just to fail, Venator.
Your mission was doomed to fail, Venator.
You never should have made me your target, Venator.
Your performative outrage is tiring, Billy.
Listening to him talk was exhausting.
Billy. We get it. Shut up.
Wesley should have picked a better student….
I wonder what Wesley saw in him.
If he's the future of the Baxter Society, they're going to be in trouble.
Yes yes, you had it so hard.
I don't care who your family is, Pocket.
You brought this upon yourself, Pocket.
Probably should have hid in your case.
The skies belong to me, Ivy.
That's what a kind heart gets you?
An icon of the community? Yes. A competent killer? No.
You made a home for yourself, Ivy… enjoy it. Don't throw away your life here.
The unicorn won't be bothering us for a while.
Glitter is the worst invention of the modern era.
The world needs change, not faux optimism.
Your loyalty to your friend is commendable but fighting me is suicide.
Mina, you're not in charge here.
I can't stand people like her.
She's like if the Id was walking around with a gun.
Put that pathetic woman out of her misery.
We have nothing to fear from Vyper.
He had no idea how much trouble he was in…
The problems of The Deep will have to wait, Viscous.
The cube was never going to be enough to save him.
You trained your whole life for this moment, Warden, and yet you still failed.
At least he died with integrity.
Say what you will about Warden, but he had conviction.
You were never going to stop me, Warden.
I won't let you stop me, Silver.
The last thing I need is Silver making a mess of things.
When she comes back, she'll want revenge.
Hope chasing a thrill was worth it to you, Wraith.
Come back and I'll have another bullet for you, Wraith.
So much for the house always winning.
Glad I stopped her when I did…
I'm not letting you cut down my friends, Yamato.
How many of you have to die before you realize it's hopeless?
It only gets worse from here.
I'll stack as many bodies as it takes to win.
No mercy comes for you today.
And so the blood begins to flow down Manhattan.
I'll try to buy us time.
And now we complete the ritual.
It's time to end this once and for all.
I shot Hathorne's brother while he was day drinking on a speedboat.
When this is over you are more than welcome to try.
Bind them sheriff. And leave the rest to me.
Forgive me for not having much faith in servants of the law.
Don't worry Detective - I'll do my part.
It was wonderful and horrifying in equal measure
I'm excited to work with you Bebop
It's nice knowing that the enemy won't be grabbing me out of the air.
That could be me or Wesley.
I'm not psychotic enough to have a preference.
Hold them in place Professor, and leave the rest to me.
I'm not a prop for show and tell
You're a professor at Columbia, yes?
Isn't that where John Hathorne will be speaking soon?
If the ritual fails, we'll be speaking later.
Didn't expect to see an Ixian carry water for Hathorne.
It's unbelievable... I was killed because people thought I was someone like you, meanwhile you're an actual monster and you get to run around like the belle of the ball.
If you want help, all you have to do is ask.
If I bind them, will you be able to finish them off?
I think I've had my fill of state sanctioned murder.
How can you work for them?
I don't know why I'm bothering to reason with a zealot.
What are you going on about?
And when the next snake appears, I'll chop off its head too
I'm dead Haze. I have all the time in the world.
Maybe later, I have people to kill
You don't look like a typical New Yorker.
Well. I uh. I hope you have good fortune far away from me.
There is no bar too low for cruelty to stoop under.
I'm surprised you're getting your hands dirty, I thought someone like you would send out goons to do the messy work.
Don't try to relate to me. You're still alive.
Let's say that's true; how do you feel about it?
I understand. I just stick with ghost for simplicities sake.
That ice dome of yours had best not block my line of sight.
That's your problem Kelvin… I am saving life.
A while. People always ask me about adapting to technology, but really the language was the hardest. For a while I felt lost, but I was able to find my way and my purpose.
That's not for you to say Kelvin. You weren't there.
You're that pit fighter, right? Lash?
I assume that means you'll be charging in.
Good. That means you'll be far away from me.
Oh I'm definitely feeling something right now.
I thought I was working with Lash.
I've heard that you’re an obnoxious pig, I'm surprised that you're so restrained.
Depends on the favor I suppose
The economic woes of assassins are not particularly my concern. Hathorne and his little marry band of bigots will die at my leisure.
You're one of Wesley's friends, right?
You can be disappointed in someone and still hold them in esteem.
How long have you had your familiar.
I died for being falsely accused of trafficking with spirits, and here you are brazenly walking about with a lich hand.
Not different enough. There's still work to do.
I was executed in the witch trials.
Are you willing to lock people inside a burning building?
If all goes well today this might be the last time we see each other.
Wesley. I just. I just wanted you to know that if I had a father like you I don't think I would have died.
It's ok. I got to meet you.
Venator's hunt the supernatural that prey on man do they not?
Do you know what I've done?
Then why are you working with me.
Oh good. A religious extremist. This bodes well for me.
No. Just cut from the same cloth.
Wesley's talked about you, you know.
That we have more in common than I think.
I love Wesley. I trust Wesley. But in this case Wesley is full of shit.
Billy, you scream at the ills of the world but you do nothing to change them.

I'm systematically murdering the bloodline of a judge that used his power to sentence innocent women to death, and in the process am dismantling an extremist neo-political movement. But do tell me about how important your soapbox is.

Tell you what Billy, when you can cleanly shoot someone running center pack in the Boston Marathon from 5 blocks away, we can trade roles. In the meantime shut up and swing your bat like a good little boy.

Ivy. We're not friends. We are not going on some adventure. When the ritual is over, you will go home to a family and I will be counting the bodies of the dead, so let's just stay focused on the task at hand.
Carlos sounds like a preschool teacher.

That you can see. For now. Ivy; some might mistake your naivety for charm but believe me when I say it is dangerous. And if you don't smarten up soon someone you care about is going to be hurt. Not everyone deserves redemption… and even fewer are capable of it.
I don't need advice from someone who knows nothing of misery.
I'm not a dancing bear, Celeste. I have goals.
You make it sound so simple. A lot of them changed their name after they got married.
I don't know how you put on a fake smile for strangers every day.
Based on your reputation I was expecting barbs, not compliments
Between the two of us I'm not liking their chances.
You're the woman infatuated with Lash, right?
Do you have a plan Vyper?
I'll do whatever it takes to win.
I'm used to blood being on my hands.
I'll put them in the dirt soon enough.
You think I'm not dangerous up close?
Better have tried to kill me.
Better I have it then them.
Well look what I found laying around.
I never say no to free souls.
Now we fight on our terms.
Don't waste your bullets on them!
Hathorne's disciples will answer for their crimes.
Justice is a fantasy for those who lack the conviction of revenge.
Today isn't the day for mercy.
The Friends of Humanity will be eradicated from this Earth.
I've been given my chance for revenge, and I won't squander it.
I was a child when they unjustly condemned me…powerless in every sense of the word. But now in death I've become all that they feared and more.
I'm not a witch. Witches are people. They have wants and dreams. All I have is revenge, and the undying will to see it through.
I'll make the world a better place, one body at a time.
Death comes for everyone eventually…I'm just giving time a helping hand.
I don't have the luxury of morality… there are lives at stake.
Might be time to stop by the curiosity shop.
I'll check the shop when I can.
I can buy something of quality.
The right purchase could make the difference.
I may want to buy something from the store.
No point in hanging onto more souls.
Another part of the ritual complete.
One less objective to worry about.
The ritual moves closer to completion.
I can do this on my own.
I have another lead to follow up on.
I don't need the Patrons to kill Hathorne.
In time you'll see things my way.
I understand. Not everyone has the stomach to do what needs to be done.
When you find your courage, call me.
Be careful out there, there's a lot of nasty things in the shadows.
Let's see 'em try to get close to me.
They won't be able to take cover.
Easier to do my job if I keep them in one place…
I'll have them right where I want them.
This could buy me the time I need.
If I'm on street level, I'm not doing my job right.
I should be able to find some fun spots to shoot from.
I will soar and they will die.
Let's see how they deal with a murder of crows.
The crows lend me their aid.
I know how to make it hurt.
If they don't have an Achilles heel, I'll make one.
Looking forward to leaving my mark…
I'm gonna tear through their defenses.
Man. Beast. Machine. There's nothing I can't kill.
Everyone has a plan until a crow tries to peck out your eyes.
I got a few tricks up my sleeve…
They're not even gonna hear the bullet that kills them…
Alright, time to get to work.
I'll pick them off one by one.
The fun's really about to start…
I really hope they try to run…
This should catch them by surprise…
So this is what Abrams feels like…
Let's try that one more time.
I'll find a place to snipe.
The birds will deal with them.
I have an omen for you…
Let's take out the Pigeon Lady.
Let's take out the Chess Player.
Let's take out the Test Pilot.
Let's take out the Rat King.
Grey Talon, I can heal you!
Check out what The Doorman bought.
I'm not ready for a team fight
Check out what Grey Talon bought.
Finally I'll get the retribution I deserve.
And now we usher in the Patron.
Today there will be a bloody reckoning.
Don't worry about me, I'll do my part.
They'll wish they never crossed paths with me.
Only one last thing stands between me and revenge.
I have a bullet with their name on it…
I have a surprise for them…
They can't hide from me forever…
Ready to take their heads off.
